confidence_notes: I ran two web searches. Restaurant meal, beer and cappuccino anchors come from Numbeo-based figures from around June 2026, as reported by Expatica, and Hikersbay figures. The main values are an inexpensive meal at about EUR 13.5, a three-course meal for two at about EUR 48-52, a 0.5 L draught beer at about EUR 3.1 and a cappuccino at about EUR 2.3-2.4. I converted these to USD at about 1.10 USD per EUR. I got that rate by dividing the RBA's 18 Nov 2026 AUD/USD rate (0.6720) by an AUD/EUR rate of 0.6115 that a third-party site attributes to the RBA. Cappuccino prices in tourist areas can be much higher, around EUR 4.5. Cocktail and wine prices were not checked directly. I estimated them from my general knowledge and the local beer price, at about EUR 9 for a cocktail and EUR 4.5 for a glass of wine, so they are less certain. Accommodation anchors are my own estimates from general knowledge for July, which is Lisbon's peak summer season. I did not search for or check any current listings, so these are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Restaurant prices are anchored to Lisbon-specific index data. Accommodation was benchmarked against other popular Southern European capitals in peak season, such as Madrid and Porto. Lisbon's room prices are around or above Madrid's in summer because of heavy tourist demand.
